messages:
Meera Raman: Heads-up — AcmeHealth private deployment is in our staging window next Tue 09:00 PT. Need quick owners/confirm on 4 gating items: network egress, NTP/time sync, signed images (tarball), KMS/HSM access. Anyone own these?

Alex Cho: I can take network. Reached out to AcmeNet ops — firewall will need explicit allow for our package endpoints + CRL and NTP. Proposed egress list (confirm pls):
```
allowed_domains:
  - packages.redwood.ai
  - crl.redwood.ai
  - kms-prod.redwood.ai
  - time.redwood.net
ports: [443, 123]
```
Also need an IP range for the jump host; Acme asked for CIDR.

Kevin Patel: Packaging/airgap status: bundle built and validated. For air-gapped site we'll provide a tarball + signature. Images exist in signed registry but for on-prem we'll export. I will sign the tarball and produce sha256. Who will host the pre-signed link?

Jake Morales: I can coordinate customer side and jump host. Putting together a short install checklist they can run after import. Quick install/verify snippet I gave them:
```bash
# verify bundle
sha256sum release-acme-2026-03-23.tar.gz
# basic egress test (runs from jump host)
curl -sS --head https://packages.redwood.ai/health-check || echo 'egress-blocked'
```

Sara Nguyen: Security note — Acme requires HSM-backed keys (FIPS). We support customer-managed HSM via PKCS11, but they need the local agent and an X.509 cert for mTLS. Need vendor name (Thales/Vormetric) and an IP allowlist for the HSM controller. Also confirm our KMS endpoint: `kms-prod.redwood.ai:443`.

infra-bot: build-bundle/176420: success — signed artifact id rb-20260323-452, sha256=6b1f9f4d2c3e7a9f0d8e5b2c4a7e8d9f3c4b2a1e5f6d7c8b9a0e1f2a3b4c5d6

Meera Raman: Owners so far: Network=Alex, Packaging=Kevin, Customer comms=Jake, Security=Sara. Outstanding blockers: (1) pre-signed S3 link for tarball (Kevin/Alex) (2) KMS/HSM connection test plan (Sara) (3) NTP/time sync policy confirmation and CIDR for jump host (Alex). Please update by EOD Fri so we can lock the canary window.

Alex Cho: @Kevin I can do the S3 upload if you push the artifact to `staging-acme` bucket. I need the ACL and expiry. I will request CIDR from AcmeNet and post it here.

Kevin Patel: Uploading now to staging-acme. Setting 48h expiry and private ACL. Tarball: `release-acme-2026-03-23.tar.gz` sha256=6b1f9f4d... Signed with key RB-SIGN-7. Pre-signed link sent to Alex via DM.

Jake Morales: Looping in AcmeOps (cc @AcmeOps on customer side). Scheduling a test hop for Mon morning. I'll send the install script + short checklist, plus the sha256 and signature instructions.

Sara Nguyen: I'll draft the KMS/HSM test plan (connectivity + sample sign/verify) and post it here by EOD. Need the HSM vendor and any certs from Acme.

Meera Raman: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. If you can post a 1-line "done" once your item is complete we can trigger the canary deploy Thurs morning. Quick ask: ping here if the customer requests longer expiry on the link or we need to extend the window.

Alex Cho: Will post CIDR and NTP policy update by EOD.

Kevin Patel: Done (uploaded + shared). Will extend expiry if Acme asks.

Jake Morales: Customer confirmed jump host schedule. Sending scripts now.

Sara Nguyen: KMS test plan posted in the Acme folder (link sent).

Meera Raman: Closing loop — everything reads green for canary. Final sync in #eng-platform on Thurs 07:30 PT.
